Don't send one of these twerps.|Han Solo|audio=Solo-Twerps.flac|}} '''Ront Byrnloo''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[pirate]] and [[bounty hunter]] who [[Jabba's criminal empire|worked]] as an enforcer for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He spent [[time]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] before accompanying Jabba to find the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] in [[Docking Bay 94]]. Byrnloo and several other thugs began searching around Solo's [[YT-1300 light freighter|ship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', but the smuggler arrived and offered to pay back the [[Galactic Credit Standard|money]] he owed the Hutt. After haggling with Solo over interest on the debt, Jabba called off Byrnloo and the others, and they left the docking bay. ==Biography== ===Visiting the cantina=== [[File:Ront_Byrnloo_at_the_cantina.png|thumb|left|250px|Ront Byrnloo was one of the patrons at Chalmun's Cantina]] A [[Corellian|native]] of the [[planet]] [[Corellia]], the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] Ront Byrnloo{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/853330463041232897|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Two newly named cantina denizens courtesy of the panel @TomSpinaDesigns and I just wrapped. #SWCO|archivefile=File:RontByrnlooTwitter.png}} was a [[pirate]] and [[bounty hunter]]{{StoryCite|story=You Owe Me a Ride|book=From a Certain Point of View}} who [[Jabba's criminal empire|served]] the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as an enforcer. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|IV|1|Ront Byrnloo's [[time]] in [[Mos Eisley]]}} Byrnloo and two other human thugs were drinking at the [[Cantina|bar]] of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the hermit [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered with the [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]]. Byrnloo and the two others then left the cantina and joined Jabba, three [[Rodian]]s, and the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] in traveling to [[Docking Bay 94]] in Mos Eisley, where the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was docked. The [[starship]] belonged to [[Han Solo]], a [[smuggler]] who worked for Jabba but owed him [[Galactic Credit Standard|money]] after dumping a shipment of the Hutt's [[spice]] in [[Realspace|space]] upon encountering an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] ship. Byrnloo and his cohorts began searching around the ship as Jabba called out to Solo to come out and meet him. ===Backing up Jabba=== {{Quote|Blast!''"
"''How many?|Senni and Brea Tonnika abandon their plan after seeing Ront Byrnloo and his companions|audio=Tonnikas-Blast.flac|}} [[File:Byrnloo_searching.png|thumb|right|250px|Ront Byrnloo accompanied Jabba the Hutt to Docking Bay 94 and searched around Han Solo's starship, the ''Millennium Falcon''.]] The sisters [[Brea Tonnika|Brea]] and [[Senni Tonnika]], who were planning on [[Thief|stealing]] the ''Falcon'', then sneaked in the back of the [[Hangar|docking bay]]. Upon seeing Byrnloo and the other thugs with Jabba, the pair abandoned their plan and left to look for a different ship. Solo, who was not aboard the ship at all, then surprised Byrnloo and the others when he addressed Jabba from the entryway to the bay, having just arrived from the nearby cantina. The Hutt chastised Solo for having not repaid him and for [[Death|killing]] [[Greedo]], another of his thugs, in the cantina. Solo then offered to repay the Hutt with interest using credits from a job he had just accepted from Kenobi. The two haggled over the interest amount that the smuggler would pay, settling on fifteen percent. Satisfied, Jabba called off his thugs, and Byrnloo and the others made their way out of the docking bay. ==Personality and traits== Ront Byrnloo had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and brown-and-gray [[hair]], including a large beard. Boba Fett considered Byrnloo and the other henchmen in Docking Bay 94 "duds" and did not believe any of them were professional,{{StoryCite|story=Added Muscle|book=From a Certain Point of View}} while Han Solo considered them all ugly.''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' ==Equipment== Ront Byrnloo carried a [[blaster pistol]] while in Docking Bay 94. The thug also wore black pants and [[boot]]s and a white, long-sleeved [[Clothing|shirt]] with a brown, sleeveless [[Jacket|duster]] over it. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:RonTarr.png|thumb|right|250px|Ron Tarr played Ront Byrnloo in ''A New Hope''.]] Ront Byrnloo was portrayed by the actor "Big" [[Ron Tarr]] in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The character was present for two scenes in the film, the cantina and the docking bay, the latter of which was cut from the original 1977 release but later included as part of the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] re-release of the film in [[1997]]. The docking bay scenes were filmed between Friday, [[April 9]], and Thursday, [[April 22]], [[1976]], on stage 3 at [[Elstree Studios]], while the cantina scenes were filmed on stage 6 at Elstree between Tuesday, [[April 12]], and Thursday, April 22.''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]'' The character went unnamed for forty years after his first appearance, until [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] named Byrnloo using a combination of the actor's name and the name of attendee [[Bryan Lewis]] at the "Behind the Scenes of the Cantina" panel at [[Celebration Orlando|''Star Wars'' Celebration Orlando]] on [[April 15]], [[2017]]. The idea of pirates accompanying Jabba to Docking Bay 94 originated in the third draft of the film's script, with the revised fourth draft''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]'' originally describing the thugs accompanying Jabba as six [[alien]] pirates and purple creatures.''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope]]'' While three Rodian aliens made it into the film, the purple
